description: Commission of Elections - Mr. H. M. M. Heenkenda elected as a member of Bandarawela M.C.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for declaring a new member elected to replace a deceased council member, including references to the returning officer, ward designation, and the legal framework governing local authority elections. This falls squarely under Election processes and related matters.
